item.caption:
🗳️🇺🇸 WE GOT OUR VOTES IN! 🇺🇸🗳️

Rob and I had been trying to get our early voting done for the past few days, but every time we went by the polling location, the lines were EXTRA long! 😩 And of course, we were either on our lunch break or had somewhere else we needed to be.

So we finally decided we would just wait until Tuesday.

Well, Sunday evening, when the rain started coming down, we both had the same thought… Let’s go vote NOW! 😂 Maybe the rain would keep the crowds away!

And guess what? It worked! 🙌🏽

We got there, and there was hardly a line at all! Plus, we weren’t rushing to get anywhere afterward. Sometimes things just work out perfectly!

So glad we made that last-minute decision. Our votes are IN, and we’ve done our civic duty! ✅🗳️

🇺🇸 Tomorrow is Election Day! If you haven’t voted yet, please make a plan to get out and VOTE!

Your voice matters. Your vote matters. ❤️🤍💙

#IVoted #EarlyVoting #ElectionDay #YourVoiceYourVote #MakeYourVoiceHeard

item.caption:
Want to know one of my biggest flexes as a mom, wife, and political scientist? Having a husband and three sons who understand that political participation is a responsibility, not an option! 

I was raised in a family of advocates and civil rights movement participants, and I'm proud to see that legacy continue through my sons.

Quincy (and Jada) are holding it down in Texas for Talarico and Hinojisa , and the rest of us are holding it down in Georgia for Keisha Lance Bottoms and Democrats down the ballot!

In this family, we don't just talk politics. We show up, we vote, and we invest our time AND money in the candidates we believe in!

Proud to have been early supporters of Keisha Lance Bottoms! ❤️

#FamilyThatVotes #EarlyVoting #IVoted #PoliticalParticipation #GeorgiaVotes
